page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top with page number at top right; a heading block (DISQUISITIO, italic question), a centred heading (CASUS IX.), a italic subtitle block, then body text in a single column. No margin notes. A catchword-like line "SEN-" at the foot right is a hyphenated word break, not a catchword.

main_text.p: non possint nocere: Eaque iis post partam victoriam esse eripienda, per quæ si amare victores nolint, victoribus non possint nocere.
main_text.head: DISQUISITIO.

p.i: An in delictis, & in quibus adversus Remp. & leges est peccatum, proximos Consiliaros & Ministros Principum mandatum Principis excuset & præstare possit impunitos?

main_text.head: CASUS IX.

head.i: Ex veteri Historia Ecclesiastica, quæ apud Theodoretum extat, petitum; Ad ea quæ in Magna Britannia hodie disceptantur, commodè referendum.

main_text.p: IULIANI Imperatoris mandato, magnus Largitionum Comes, magnæ apud eum authoritatis & intimæ gratiæ, Beristiorum qui Phoeniciæ Metropolin incolebant, operis pulcherrimi templum incendit.
Sub Ioviano Cæsare, paulò post quæsitum est: An non ob tanti sceleris præstitam executionem magno Largitionum Comiti pœna imponi debeat?

page.notes: The first letter I of IULIANI is a large initial, rendered as plain I. The word "Beristiorum" and "Phoeniciæ" are as printed. Possible printing errors left as printed: "Remp.", "Metropolin", "Iovicano" printed as Iovicano (read as Ioviano). Catchword-like "SEN-" at the foot is a broken word (Sententia) and is kept as printed.
